title: QUBO benchmark catalog: 200, 500, 1000 variables; sparse and dense
contents_note: This is a catalog of source URLs and reference values, not a downloaded matrix archive.
reference_status_note: Published proven optima are distinguished from the best published objective values located. The latter are not guaranteed to be an exhaustive worldwide latest record and are not presented as proven optima.
density_definition: For a quadratic polynomial, density = nonzero coefficients for unordered off-diagonal pairs / (n*(n-1)/2). Native-family densities are nominal source settings, not recalculated measurements.
objective_convention: All reference values are normalized for MINIMIZATION. A symmetric x.T@Q@x counts each off-diagonal matrix entry twice.
comparison_note: Report the six size-density groups separately. Native random QUBO and maximum-clique QUBO are different structural families; density is not their only difference.

instances.density_note: Nominal source density; measure the exact off-diagonal nonzero density after parsing.
instances.input_format: Biq Mac sparse symmetric matrix triples
instances.normalization: Minimize x.T @ Q @ x. Mirror off-diagonal matrix entries. Negate Q for an OR-Library maximization input.
instances.vector_note: A published objective-value target was located; a downloadable matching bitstring was not verified.

instances.input_format: DIMACS ASCII edge-list; p edge n m then e i j, with 1-based vertex labels
instances.normalization: Minimize -sum_i x_i + 2*sum_{i<j, {i,j} not in E} x_i*x_j. Symmetric Q: Q_ii=-1, Q_ij=Q_ji=1 on nonedges; otherwise zero. Constant=0. No extra variables.
instances.solution_file_format: First line: clique cardinality, search nodes, time in milliseconds. Second line: selected vertex labels.
instances.validation_note: Published instance headers and exact-solver results were inspected. The witness was not independently evaluated against a downloaded graph in this session.
